sequence_points.name: Abstract Landscape with Earth Tones
sequence_points.description: A horizontal abstract painting featuring layered earthy tones of brown, orange, and gray, with hints of teal at the bottom. The composition suggests a natural landscape with flowing forms resembling rock formations or water erosion, mounted on a white wall in a gallery setting.

sequence_points.name: Brown Textured Wall Panel
sequence_points.description: A rectangular panel with a uniform brown, wood-grain texture, mounted on a wall. The surface appears smooth and consistent in color and pattern.
